content: Paywall anger is the #1 complaint theme in baby tracker reviews: Huckleberry (no trial no warning, widgets paywalled), Nighp (permanent Plus banner, broken restore purchases, ads for prior purchasers, forced AI update Sept 2026 caused 1-star wave), Baby Connect (read-only after trial). Data hostage risk is real. Counter-examples loved: one-time purchase apps (Baby Feed Timer, Vaava 90% free + lifetime IAP).
